image_description: A close-up shot of a glossy, bright pink ceramic cup (mug) sitting on a wooden surface. A silver spoon is inserted into the cup, with only the handle visible protruding from the top. The background is a soft-focus, muted green wall. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the cup's rim and handle.

To verify the structural integrity of the handle attachments and ensure there is no 'melting' or fusion between the handle and the cup body.
To check for subtle artifacts where the spoon enters the cup and along the high-contrast rim edge.
To ensure the cup sits naturally on the table surface without floating or shadow inconsistencies.
